newsitem.title: PANAMA: Ecuador's former leader victim of theft in Panama.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's former leader victim of theft in Panama.

text.p: Thieves broke into the Panama City office of Ecuador's former president Abdala Bucaram on Tuesday and stole computer equipment and files, police said.

Two computers, a fax machine, files and a draft copy of Bucaram's autobiography were reported stolen from the office, located in an apartment building in the city's banking sector, a police spokesman said.
Bucaram was deposed in February by Ecuador's Congress on grounds of "mental incompetence" after only six months in power.
From Panama, where he has obtained political asylum, he has repeatedly denounced interim President Fabian Alarcon for orchestrating his ouster with the military.
Ricardo Bustamante, a Bucaram spokesman described the robbery as "an attempt to cripple our communications."
